{{Navbar-GlobalBioenergyPowerTracker}}
'''Vinca Waste-to-Energy power station''' is an operating power station of at least 30-megawatts (MW) in City of Belgrade, Central Serbia, Serbia.
It is also known as Vinča Waste to Energy Plant, Belgrade Waste-to-Energy.
